university.name: Goldsmiths, University of London
university.summary: A university on a single campus in south-east London, teaching undergraduate and postgraduate courses in computing, management, media and other subjects. It publishes an information page for applicants from Pakistan and a scholarships finder for international students.

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.duration_text: 3 years full-time; 4 years with an optional placement year
courses.overview: A three-year undergraduate computing degree with an optional placement year. The first year covers programming, web development, algorithms, computer architecture and a computing project.
courses.academic_requirements: A-level CCC; BTEC DMM; International Baccalaureate 27 points overall with three Higher Level subjects at 555.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall with no component below 5.5, or an equivalent English qualification.
courses.career_notes: Graduate roles listed on the page include software engineer, data analyst, machine learning developer and full-stack web developer.
courses.application_deadline_note: No deadline stated; the page links to UCAS for full-time applications.
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published: the page gives GBP 23,000 for the 2026/27 academic year. The page does not state an intake month or year. No Pakistan-specific entry requirement is published on the pages opened.

courses.title: Data Science and Artificial Intelligence
courses.overview: A one-year taught master's covering data programming, machine learning, artificial intelligence, big data analysis and neural networks, completed with a 60-credit final project. Part-time study is not currently possible for international students on a student visa.
highlights: Final Project in Data Science (compulsory, 60 credits)
courses.academic_requirements: A BA or BSc at 2:2 or above in a subject such as computer science, mathematics, statistics, engineering, or a quantitative subject such as economics or finance. Programming experience is not assumed.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall with no element lower than 6.0, or an equivalent qualification.
courses.career_notes: The page says the programme prepares students for data science roles and refers to an Industry Advisory Board and an optional placement.
courses.application_deadline_note: No deadline listed; applications are made online.
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published: the page gives GBP 21,000 for the 2026/27 academic year. The page does not state an intake month or year. Three optional modules (45 credits) are chosen from a changing list.

courses.title: Business Management
courses.overview: A one-year taught master's with 150 credits of compulsory modules, including data analysis, strategic management, project management and a 60-credit research project, plus 30 credits of options.
courses.academic_requirements: An undergraduate degree of at least second class standard, from any discipline. Applicants with at least three years in management, marketing or entrepreneurial roles may be considered case by case.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall with 6.0 in writing, or an equivalent English qualification. The page gives no other component scores.
courses.experience_requirements: Not required with a degree; three years in management, marketing or entrepreneurial roles for applicants applying on experience.
courses.career_notes: The page refers to management careers in large companies, entrepreneurial businesses, government institutions and social enterprises or charities.
courses.application_deadline_note: No deadline listed; applicants choose the start date when they apply.
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published: the page gives GBP 23,000 for 2026/27. Intake years not stated. Degree class set to 2:2 from the wording 'at least second class standard', which does not name a division. Part-time study is not currently possible for international students on a student visa.

courses.title: Journalism: Digital, Broadcast, News, Features and Magazines
courses.overview: A one-year taught master's in journalism with compulsory modules in journalism in context and multimedia news reporting, a 60-credit final project and 60 credits of options such as broadcast, mobile and podcast, or data journalism.
highlights: Optional: Broadcast Journalism; Data, AI and Forensic Journalism; Mobile and Podcast Journalism
courses.academic_requirements: An undergraduate degree of at least second class standard (or expected), plus evidence of some journalism or equivalent experience.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 7.0 overall with 7.5 in writing and no element below 6.5, or an equivalent qualification.
courses.experience_requirements: Evidence of some journalism or equivalent experience.
courses.career_notes: The page names alumni working at outlets including the Guardian, Reuters, the BBC and the Financial Times, and says students are expected to seek work experience.
courses.application_deadline_note: The page states there is no application deadline and encourages early applications.
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published: the page gives GBP 21,000 for 2026/27. The page does not state an intake month or year. Degree class set to 2:2 from the wording 'at least second class standard', which does not name a division. Part-time study is not currently possible for international students on a student visa.
